problem_statement: The event callback API must provide a one-shot helper event_callback_oneshot usable as event_callback_oneshot(&oneshot, EVENT_PRIO_MEDIUM, _event_cb, "event 0"). It must make the supplied callback execute once on the supplied event queue with the supplied argument, so the callback is observable immediately after the call and before later callback events are processed.

verification.reason: The statement provides the exact function name, its calling convention, the required behaviour (execute once on the supplied queue with the supplied argument), and the timing constraint (observable before later callback events). The hidden tests check exactly these properties, and all symbols used are either pre-existing or specified in the statement.
